request.description:
Reorder a visit's token number within the same doctor/session/date. Only visits with status 'Scheduled' or 'In Progress' can be reordered. Other visits in the queue will be automatically shifted to accommodate the new position.

Example: If current queue is [1,2,3,4,5] and you move token 5 to position 2, the result will be [1,2(was 5),3(was 2),4(was 3),5(was 4)].

Note: Completed, Cancelled, and No Show visits are not affected by reordering. If newTokenNumber exceeds the maximum token in queue, the visit will be moved to the end.
